listing.name: Ratchet & Clank — OpenRAC (OpenRAC)
listing.summary: Launcher release carries first native port; unmatched assembly skipped. SDK releases and matching progress do not imply all six playable. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: RAC1 PAL SCES-50916 is first native target; own ISO. RAC1 NTSC SCUS97199; RAC2 SCUS97268; RAC3 SCUS97353; Deadlocked SCUS97465; Size Matters SCUS97615; Secret Agent SCUS97623 are distinct decomp scopes, not established player ports.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Download OpenRAC launcher; carries native RAC1 PAL runtime and preparation tools; select own ISO folder. Other game rows are matching-decomp research, not player targets.
